title: Feature Pipeline Compiler
description: Compiles sklearn-style feature engineering pipelines. Enforces sklearn Pipeline usage (preventing leakage), fit-on-train-only, no chained pandas assignment, no target leakage, feature name documentation, and reproducible transforms.

error_codes.FP002: sklearn Pipeline not used — raw sequential transforms risk data leakage
error_codes.FP003: Pandas chained assignment (df['col']['row']) — use df.loc[row, col]
error_codes.FP004: Transformer.fit() called on test data — leaks test distribution into transforms
error_codes.FP005: Target column (y) used as input feature — target leakage detected
error_codes.FP006: Transformer fit outside sklearn Pipeline — must fit on train only via pipeline
error_codes.FP007: Random transformer has no random_state — transforms are not reproducible
error_codes.FP008: Feature names not exported (get_feature_names_out / feature_names_in not used)
